title: 第六章 你为什么还活着第七章 任务完成
content_zh:
十几分钟后，周游如愿见到了那名女性。
和她的丈夫一样，这位的年龄也在四五十岁左右，身上穿着一件布满尘土的清洁工服，长相沧桑神情呆滞，就仿佛已经艰难的生活磨平了所有的棱角。她此时似乎也是不知道发生了什么事，正紧张地拽着衣角，局促不安的望着周游.。
周游倒也没着急说话，而是在这名女清洁工和那个脂肪怪物间扫了几眼。
这个女工是怪物刚刚叫来的。
但是问题是她对这个怪物却没有一丝一毫的恐惧之感，偶尔看向其的目光中，只有对于寻常吝啬上司那种不安和惧怕。
所以说.....
——是我看到的景色和他们不一样。
还是说他们的感知受到了某种污染，根本无法认知到真实的情况？
周游思考了一会，却仍然无法找出解答，而且那个脂肪怪物就在身边，也同样没法进行详问，于是只能轻叹一口气，接着对那女工介绍起自己。
“你好，我是隶属于省电视台的调查记者，名字叫周游，我这次是想.....”
谁想到听到‘记者’两个字后，一直表现怯弱的女清洁工陡然焦急了起来。
“.....我家那位的事又被翻出来了？？”
“额...不是......”
“还是说你们又想来堵我家门了？”
“也不是.....”
“我家那孩子真扛不住更多骚扰了，本来他就因为父亲去世情绪不稳，下个学期的学费也不知道从哪弄呢，然后你们还天天上门采访骚扰——”
.........不是，这个剧本不听人说话是传统吗？
对方情绪越来越激动——并且还不止激动，就见随着她的哭诉，那脖子上的头也如吹气球般涨大，眼见得即将蜕要变成一只新的怪物——
“等等，我就是给你送学费来的！”
一声大喊。

异化的样子骤地停住。
“你说...什么？”
看到女清洁工终于停了下来，周游立刻用最为和善的声音安抚道。
“大姨，你别害怕，我不是那些小报作者，因为前段时间师傅他协助破获了一桩案件，省里为此发下了一笔特别奖金，但是由于当时不知道身份，直到才找到了他的所在地。”
周游打量了一下女工的表情，见到没什么变化，才继续说道。
“可惜的是，在我们找到时他本人已经过世了，我最近正好在这负责几桩采访，于是就想顺道把这笔钱交到您手里。顺便看看能不能为此开个表彰追悼会什么的，请您放心，我真不是来骚扰您的。”
这临时编出来的谎言有不少漏洞，不过忽悠一名普普通通的中年妇女已经足够，那名女工的脑袋渐渐缩小，最后又变成了那张胆怯的面容。
“......小兄弟，您说的是真的？”
“当然是真的。”周游为了加强自己的说服力，还特地从怀里掏出那一摞厚厚的钞票——反正不是自己的，送给别人也不心疼。“你看，这钱就是省里发下来的奖金，您现在就能拿走，而且也不用担心被别人强取豪夺什么的，过几天电视台可能会为这个案件做一个专项节目，如果有人想这么干的话，他就等于打整个市里整个领导阶层的脸。”
说罢，周游转过头，看向某个脂肪怪物。
content_en:
Ten minutes later, Zhou You saw the woman as he wished.
Like her husband, this man was also in his forties or fifties. He was wearing a dusty cleaner's uniform. He looked dull and had a dull look, as if all the edges had been smoothed away by a difficult life. She didn't seem to know what was going on at this time. She was nervously tugging at the corner of her clothes and looking at Zhou You uneasily.
Zhou You was not in a hurry to speak, but glanced between the female cleaner and the fat monster.
This female worker was just called by the monster.
But the problem is that she doesn't have the slightest feeling of fear towards this monster. When she occasionally looks at it, she only has the uneasiness and fear of an ordinary stingy boss.
So...
——The scenery I saw was different from theirs.
Or is it that their perception has been contaminated in some way and they are simply unable to recognize the real situation?
Zhou You thought about it for a while, but still couldn't find the answer. Moreover, the fat monster was beside him, so he couldn't ask in detail, so he could only sigh softly and then introduce himself to the female worker.
"Hello, I am an investigative reporter affiliated with the provincial TV station. My name is Zhou You. What I want to do this time is..."
Who would have thought that after hearing the word 'reporter', the timid female cleaner suddenly became anxious.
".....The case of that person in my family has been revealed again??"
"Um...no..."
"Or are you trying to block my door again?"
"No..."
"My child really can't handle any more harassment. He was already emotionally unstable because of his father's death, and he doesn't know where to get the tuition for the next semester. And then you still come to interview and harass him every day -"
.........No, is it tradition for this script not to listen to people?
The other party was getting more and more excited - and she was not only excited, but as she cried, the head on her neck swelled up like a balloon, and it seemed that she was about to transform into a new monster -
"Wait a minute, I'm here to give you tuition!"
A shout.
The alienated look suddenly stopped.
"You said...what?"
Seeing that the cleaning lady finally stopped, Zhou You immediately comforted her with the kindest voice.
"Auntie, don't be afraid. I'm not one of those tabloid writers. Because my master helped solve a case some time ago, the province paid a special bonus for it. However, because I didn't know his identity at the time, I didn't find his whereabouts until now."
Zhou You looked at the female worker's expression and saw that there was no change before continuing.
"Unfortunately, he had already passed away when we found him. I happened to be in charge of a few interviews here recently, so I wanted to hand this money over to you. By the way, I want to see if we can hold a memorial service to commend him. Please rest assured, I am really not here to harass you."
There were many loopholes in this improvised lie, but it was enough to fool an ordinary middle-aged woman. The female worker's head gradually shrank, and finally turned into that timid face.
"...Little brother, are you telling the truth?"
"Of course it's true." In order to strengthen his persuasiveness, Zhou You took out the thick stack of banknotes from his arms - it was not his own anyway, so he didn't feel bad giving it to others. "Look, this money is a bonus from the province. You can take it now, and you don't have to worry about being robbed by others. In a few days, the TV station may do a special program on this case. If someone wants to do this, he will slap the entire city's leadership in the face."
After saying that, Zhou You turned his head and looked at a fat monster.
